name: EchoMimicV3-Flash — photo to half-body talking video WITH hand gestures
status: experimental — needs a 12 GB+ NVIDIA GPU; not runnable in the CI sandbox
notes: Best open gesture model in this catalog. Speed (paper): 5 s of half-body video ≈ 4 min on an A100 (standard); Flash is 8-step. Expect a 30 s short to take 10-30 min on an RTX 4090, much longer on a T4.
